'''Pulkay''' was a type of clear [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] favored by the populace of [[Farpoint]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fhost]]. It had many varieties, which included spiced pulkay.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
